newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open flat to 0.5 cent firmer Tuesday as LME reopened overnight following a public holiday Monday.
The LME backwardation was slightly firmer at $70/$72 from last Friday.
LME stocks rose 1,000 tonnes Tuesday to 148,925 tonnes.
Monday, COMEX stocks fell 1,064 short tons to 47,091 short tons.
COMEX July copper settled at 110.45 cents a lb Monday, and traded between 110.50 and 110.40 cents on ACCESS.
Broker Macquarie Equities Ltd said the drought in Chile could cause potentially more serious production problems than the labor disputes.
Unless there was heavy rain within the next month, power cuts to major copper mines were likely, Macquarie said.
